acceptance.assertion: T058 starts only after T057 is verified and exposes an immutable exact-head handoff containing repository, pull request, base and head SHAs, full diff SHA-256, user-visible diff receipt, exact-head reviews, required CI and unresolved-thread readback.
Acquire and continuously retain an exclusive repo.grabowski claim for the merge attempt; any foreign repository mutation, merge, rebase, conflicting lease or unknown ownership blocks the task.

Immediately before merge, reread pull-request state, current base, exact head, mergeability, required checks, reviews, review threads, branch policy, automatic platform effects and delivery receipt. Any changed head, stale evidence, unresolved finding, failed or pending required check, conflict or unknown state blocks the merge.

T058 does not edit, amend, force-push, rebase or otherwise mutate the T057 pull-request head. If the head needs modification or rebase, stop and register or execute a separate appropriately claimed task.
Merge exactly the verified T057 pull-request head through the canonical guarded path with explicit effect scope. Do not bypass review, CI, delivery, policy, human-authorization or exact-head gates.

After merge, read back pull-request state and Grabowski main and record the exact merge commit SHA, resulting tree SHA, reviewed head SHA, pre-merge base SHA, merge method and automatic platform effects. This exact merge commit, not a later containing main head, is T059 deployment input.
T058 performs no deployment, service restart, timer replacement, host mutation, connector refresh or live stale-poll proof and grants no break-glass authority to T059.

approval.note: T058 is a separate exclusive merge phase required by Bureau AGENTS.md and Codex review on PR #1060. It may merge only the exact verified T057 handoff; it may not modify or rebase the head and has no runtime authority.

goal: After T057 is verified, acquire an exclusive Grabowski repository claim and merge exactly its reviewed pull-request head through the canonical guarded merge path without changing, rebasing or redeploying that head. Record the exact resulting merge revision and tree as the sole deployment input for T059.

does_not_establish: authority to interrupt foreign work or release foreign leases

review_correction.finding: Implementation, merge and deployment require three separate authority phases; deployment must pin the exact merge revision rather than a later containing main head.

rollback.strategy: If the merge is later proven wrong, create a separate exclusive repository rollback task bound to the recorded merge commit and revert it through review and guarded merge. T058 itself performs no deployment rollback and never rewrites shared history.

title: Merge reviewed stale-poll hardening exclusively
